invariants: No SQL executes outside the owner-scoped transaction, including the readiness probe.
A call that fails because the connection broke surfaces as AdapterError::Unavailable; the session is then dead and is never silently reconnected.
PgSession is not Sync and is never shared: one session, one connection, one thread.
responsibilities: Own the PgConfig, a tokio current-thread Runtime, and the tokio_postgres Client; all fields private.

connect(): validate the config, build the runtime, connect with NoTls, spawn the connection driver onto the runtime, apply the statement timeout, then prove readiness with one owner-scoped SELECT 1 round trip before returning.
Every call_* runs ONE transaction: set_config('forge.coding_owner', owner, true) first, then SELECT <the given select expression>, then commit. Dropping the transaction uncommitted rolls back.
call_scalar is the only generic path; call_json/call_bool/call_text/call_void are thin specializations or siblings with the same transaction discipline.
summary: One adapter session: a tokio-postgres client behind a synchronous facade, and the owner-scoped transaction every call runs in.
